notes: Mechanical strategy on fully closed 4H candles, entry next 4H open. LONG mediumR->weakR, SHORT mediumB->weakB. Stop beyond most recent CONFIRMED price pivot (left 2/3, right 1/2) plus 0.1%/0.2% buffer; no ATR, no TP. Opposite DeltaRSI weak color closes at next 4H open. Max holding 120 4H bars is a data safety limit, not trader rule. 0.15% roundtrip costs, no funding. Conservative stop check before signal exit on each bar. Strict 50/25/25 per-asset split; positions forcibly end at split boundary (limitation). 48 configurations chosen on train+validation; holdout not used to select. This does NOT yet use forming 4H 1H snapshots or partial manual exits. Results do not establish true OOS on BTC since rules were inferred from BTC journal.
